title: Claude Code 2.1.77 - Stability and Capability Update
description: Released on March 16, 2026, as part of Anthropic's bi-weekly update cycle. This update brings stability improvements and capability enhancements for Claude Opus 4.6. March 2026 also saw the introduction of Voice Mode supporting 20 languages, remote control enhancements, and customizable keybindings.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code generates cleaner, more shareable code compared to Codex which is better at reasoning
Developer created a Palantir-like surveillance clone in 2 hours using Claude Code
Vibe coding a landing page with Claude Code

title: Cursor 2.5 with Long-Running Agents and Composer 1.5
description: Released on February 17, 2026 (active through March 2026). This major update introduced long-running agents for extended task handling and Composer 1.5. The 2026 updates also brought improved tab completion with context-aware code suggestions that understand entire codebases.

title: Copilot SDK Technical Preview and GPT-5.2-Codex GA
description: January 2026 updates active through March 2026 featuring the Copilot SDK technical preview for building integrations at scale, GPT-5.2-Codex graduating to General Availability, and new agent mode with autonomous task planning. Visual Studio 2026 integration includes upgraded chat and language-aware symbol navigation.

community_feedback.quote: Copilot excels at boilerplate (76% acceptance rate) but struggles with debugging (12% acceptance rate)

title: Plan Mode Launch and Nightly Update
description: March 11, 2026 saw the launch of 'Plan mode' allowing complex research and migration planning tasks. A major nightly update brought UI polish, core fixes, chat resume footer, enhanced PTY support for interactive commands, and telemetry improvements with Google Cloud integration.

title: Codex App 26.228 - Performance and Security Updates
description: Late February 2026 updates (active through March 2026) including version 26.228 with performance improvements and bug fixes, and security fixes for CVE-2026-24842. Codex CLI is described as faster and more reliable with better real-time collaboration and autonomous task capabilities.

title: Version 1.26.0 - Bedrock and OpenRouter Integration
description: Recent release adding API key authentication support for AWS Bedrock provider and OpenRouter API integration with Anthropic prompt caching support. The 2026 updates focus on multi-model support and enhanced privacy features.
